blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Collaborative reconstruction with consumer phones promises faster and more complete indoor maps. However, heterogeneous devices introduce degraded observations and unreliable cross-device associations, so a single poor contributor or incorrect match can corrupt the shared Gaussian map. To address this, we propose \textbf{CADENCE}, a collaborative Gaussian simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system that separates finding cross-device matches from deciding whether and how peer observations update the map. To find matches, a sensor-grounded regional memory summarizes committed observations and ranks candidate peer regions using appearance, relative pose, gravity, barometric altitude, and observation quality. Deterministic geometric verification and optional physical checks then decide which of the proposed matches are accepted. Once a match is accepted, separate cue-based confidences control how its observations contribute to pose constraints, geometry, appearance, and memory. As a result, useful depth can still contribute even when color is unreliable. Throughout this process, local tracking remains isolated from mapping, verification, and networking. We evaluate CADENCE on eight Matterport3D houses that were not used to train the memory. On these houses, regional memory achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of $0.95$ to $0.97$ and thus outperforms appearance retrieval, while verification keeps false-link rates below $0.5\,\%$. Furthermore, soft confidence weighting reduces the mean receiver peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) loss from $2.66$ to $1.05$\,dB across eight degradations while retaining useful peer depth. Finally, using inertial and platform motion, CADENCE tracks all twelve held-out iPhone scans with a mean absolute trajectory error of $6.98$\,cm, and its refined maps achieve better average rendering quality than the baselines.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: When several phones scan the same environment, they can cover more areas than a single phone. However, different phones may capture different lighting conditions, exposure levels, motion blur, depth quality, and tracking reliability. As a result, one phone may correctly recognize a place but still provide unreliable data that reduces the quality of another phone’s map. A collaborative system must therefore do two things: identify matching places and decide which information from another phone is reliable enough to add to the map.
blocks.zh: 当几个电话扫描同一个环境时,它们可以覆盖比单个电话更多的区域. 然而,不同的电话可能捕捉到不同的照明条件,曝光水平,运动模糊度,深度质量,以及跟踪可靠性. 因此,一个电话可能正确识别出一个地方,但仍提供不可靠的数据来降低另一个电话地图的质量。 因此,一个协作系统必须做两件事:确定匹配位置,并决定从另一个电话得到哪些信息足够可靠,可以添加到地图上.

blocks.en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) can create detailed 3D scene representations [ 27 ] . It has also been used in dense simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) systems [ 34 ] . Similar approaches include SplaTAM [ 23 ] and PhotoSLAM [ 21 ] . Collaborative Gaussian SLAM systems combine observations from multiple devices using appearance matching and geometric or photometric registration. Examples include the method presented in [ 53 , 51 ] . However, finding the correct place does not mean that every type of information in the matched observation is reliable. Research on collaborative perception also shows that differences between contributing devices can reduce the quality of a shared result [ 14 ] . Therefore, a collaborative reconstruction system must check how useful each type of incoming evidence is for the receiving map, while allowing the phone to continue tracking its own movement.

blocks.en: CADENCE addresses this problem by separating three steps: ranking possible matches, checking whether a match is geometrically valid, and deciding which matched information can update the map (Fig. 1 ). It uses a sensor-grounded world-consistency memory (SG-WCM) to summarize committed observations within spatial regions. This memory ranks candidate regions from other devices using appearance, relative pose, gravity, barometric altitude, and observation quality. Deterministic geometric tests decide whether a proposed match can be accepted, with optional physical checks providing additional verification. Separate confidence values then control how accepted peer evidence affects pose constraints, geometry, appearance, and memory. The explicit map remains the main source of truth, while local tracking proceeds independently of background collaboration. On unseen Matterport3D [ 5 ] houses, the regional memory improves region ranking over appearance retrieval, achieving an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.95 0.95 to 0.97 0.97 , while geometric verification limits false associations. Soft confidence weighting removes the 3.73 3.73 dB own-view peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) loss from a low-light peer while retaining its depth, and live iPhone sessions demonstrate collaboration with low tracking latency. The contributions of this paper are summarized as follows: 1. A sensor-grounded regional memory that ranks cross-device regions from committed appearance and sensor evidence, with capped embedding storage and single-stage training. 2. Collaborative fusion that verifies memory-ranked cross-device matches using feature correspondences and available depth before admitting peer updates, keeping false-link rates below 0.5 % 0.5\,\% on unseen Matterport3D houses. 3. Confidence-governed sharing that controls peer updates to pose constraints, geometry, appearance, and memory; soft weighting reduces mean receiver PSNR loss from 2.66 2.66 to 1.05 1.05 dB across eight degradations. 4. A native mobile implementation that isolates tracking from background collaboration and validates accelerated operators against CPU references, maintaining a 95th-percentile pose time below 33.3 33.3 ms in live iPhone sessions.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
ORB-SLAM3 [ 3 ] provides feature-based visual-inertial localization, while iMAP [ 44 ] and Point-SLAM [ 37 ] learn dense neural scene representations.
3D Gaussian Splatting [ 27 ] offers an explicit representation for dense mapping.
MonoGS [ 34 ] and SplaTAM [ 23 ] use photometric tracking, GS-ICP SLAM [ 15 ] aligns depth geometrically, and Photo-SLAM [ 21 ] runs sparse feature tracking alongside mapping.
Gaussian-SLAM [ 54 ] adds submaps, LoopSplat [ 56 ] adds loop closure, and MM3DGS SLAM [ 45 ] and VIGS-SLAM [ 57 ] incorporate inertial constraints.
Extending these maps across agents requires place matching and alignment.
Sparse systems such as COVINS [ 38 ] and Kimera-Multi [ 47 ] exchange place descriptors and reject inconsistent inter-agent relations, including through pairwise consistency maximization [ 33 ] .
Swarm-SLAM [ 28 ] prioritizes verification under a communication budget, while AnyLoc [ 24 ] uses frozen foundation features for place recognition.
Dense systems share neural points in CP-SLAM [ 18 ] or Gaussians in MAC-Ego3D [ 51 ] and OminiMAG-SLAM [ 11 ] .
The closest systems, MAGiC-SLAM [ 53 ] , CoMA-SLAM [ 6 ] , GRAND-SLAM [ 46 ] and MAGS-SLAM [ 4 ] , retrieve candidates by appearance, verify them geometrically or photometrically, and align submaps.
CADENCE follows this structure while ranking regions using committed sensor evidence.
Its association study varies only the proposal policy, keeping the tracker, mapper and verifier fixed.
blocks.zh:
ORB-SLAM3 [3]提供以地貌为主的视觉-惯性局部化,而iMAP [44]和Point-SLAM [37]则学习了密集神经场景表现.
3D高斯平板画[27]为密集地绘制地图提供了明确的体现.
MonoGS [34]和SplaTAM [23] 使用光度测量跟踪,GS-ICP SLAM [15] 将深度几何坐标对齐,而相片-SLAM [21] 运行了与绘图平行的稀有地物跟踪.
Gaussian-SLAM [54] 添加了子映射,LoopSplate [56] 添加了回环闭合,而MM3DGS SLAM [45]和VIGS-SLAM [57] 包含惯性约束.
将这些地图扩展至代理需要位置匹配和对齐.
诸如COVINS[38]和Kimera-Multi [47] 等 Sparse systems 互换标记并拒绝不一致的代理关系,包括通过对等一致性最大化[33].
Swarm-SLAM [28] 在通信预算下优先进行核查,而AnyLoc [24] 则使用被冻结的地基特征进行位置识别.
dense systems在CP-SLAM [18] 中共享神经分数,或在MAC-Ego3D [51]和OminiMAG-SLAM [11]中共享高斯分数.
最近的系统,MAgiC-SLAM[53],CoMA-SLAM[6],GRAND-SLAM[46]和MAGS-SLAM[4],通过外观取回候选者,通过几何或光度来验证它们,并调整子图.
CADENCE遵循这个结构,同时使用承诺的传感器证据对区域进行排名.
其关联研究仅对建议书政策有差异,保持了跟踪器,映射器和验证器的固定.

blocks.en:
Even after a match is accepted, some shared observations may still fail to improve the receiving map.
Collaborative perception addresses this reliability problem: Where2comm [ 20 ] weights shared features by spatial confidence, STAMP [ 14 ] studies compatibility between heterogeneous contributors, and consensus checks identify adversarial teammates [ 29 ] .
In mapping, DGOMapping [ 30 ] weights observations by quality, visibility and cross-agent depth consistency, while CG-SLAM [ 17 ] reweights depth using per-pixel uncertainty.
CADENCE gives each modality of an accepted peer contribution a separate permission and measures its effect on the receiving Gaussian map, including negative transfer.
These peer-update decisions operate outside the pose path, allowing tracking to continue independently of collaboration.
Mobile deployment adds constraints on computation and depth sensing.
CGS-SLAM [ 10 ] evaluates client reconstruction on a laptop graphics processing unit (GPU) and offloads metric depth estimation to a server.
CADENCE uses sensor depth and runs tracking and mapping natively on Apple devices.
blocks.zh:
即使在接受匹配后,一些共享的观测仍然可能无法改进接收地图.
协作感应解决这一可靠性问题: Where2comm [20] 权重通过空间自信共享特征,STAMP [14] 研究不同贡献者之间的相容性,共识检查确定对抗队友 [29].
在绘图中,DGOMapping[30]按质量,能见度和跨物剂深度一致性来加权观测,而CG-SLAM[17]则利用每像素不确定性来重新加权深度.
CADENCE给予被接受的同伴贡献的每一种模式单独的许可并衡量其对接收高斯地图的影响,包括负转移.
这些同行更新的决定在外出运行,使得追踪能够独立于合作而继续.
移动部署增加了对计算和深度感知的限制。
CGS-SLAM [10] 在笔记本电脑图形处理单元(GPU)上评价客户端重建,并卸载到服务器上的度量深度估计.
CADENCE使用传感器深度,并在苹果设备上进行本土跟踪和映射.

If either agent lacks usable metric depth, the system falls back to a monocular path.
In this case, it triangulates features at the tracked poses and filters them by reprojection error.
For matching, this path uses scale-invariant feature transform (SIFT) keypoints [ 31 ] with hashed RootSIFT descriptors [ 1 ] , which are exchanged in the same binary packet format.
Because metric depth is unavailable, a consistency test replaces the depth test.
Specifically, the forward and reverse pose estimates must agree in one direction, while reprojection verification remains in place.
To further stabilize the estimate, the path also applies a stronger gyroscope prior ( Sec. D.10 ).
Finally, since the triangulated depths inherit the scale of the tracked translation, the system trusts monocular translation only once that scale is metric ( Sec. D.1 ).

blocks.en:
We evaluate local reconstruction on Replica-8 [ 41 , 44 ] and collaboration on MA-Replica [ 18 ] and time-interleaved three-agent Matterport3D (MP3D) walks [ 5 ] .
ScanNet++ [ 52 ] provides iPhone images, LiDAR depth, real IMU data and ARKit poses, whereas barometers and other inertial streams are synthetic.
We tune on the development split (DEV), select configurations on the validation split (VAL) and evaluate held-out splits once after freezing, with TEST3 as the last of three disjoint held-out phone splits.
We fixed acceptance thresholds before the collaboration studies, and memory training excludes the eight test houses and the held-out phone scenes ( Secs. B.1 and C ).

blocks.en: On Replica VAL scenes office0 and office1, we compare the guard, soft weighting, ungated sharing, equal weights and frame rejection under one geometric verifier (Table S7 ). Own-view luma PSNR change against Solo measures receiver harm outside the peer window; peer-only-region change against Merge measures sharing benefit. Across eight degradations, soft weighting reduces mean own-view loss from 2.66 2.66 to 1.05 1.05 dB, improves on ungated sharing in seven conditions and retains peer-region gains in six (Fig. 3 d, two-scene means). Frame rejection causes less receiver harm but largely forfeits these gains. Under low light, soft weighting removes the receiver loss while retaining useful depth. The guard limits this loss to 0.40 0.40 dB and reduces peer-region depth error by 17.39 17.39 cm while withholding unreliable color (Table S8 ). This supports treating appearance and geometry separately: poor color need not invalidate useful depth. Soft weighting nevertheless causes less mean receiver harm than the guard in all eight conditions. Most effects arise in office0; office1 establishes its first link late and integrates at most two guarded peer keyframes in seven conditions (Table S9 ). Exposure mismatch and noisy transmitted poses still pass the confidence tests, showing that observation quality alone does not establish compatibility with the receiver map. An additional depth check renders peer keyframes against that map and reduces the guard’s mean own-view loss under noisy transmitted poses from 5.29 5.29 to 1.25 1.25 dB, while retaining a peer-region gain. The improvement is concentrated in office0, and the check remains outside the default system and misses IMU-corrupted peer poses ( Sec. B.1 ).

blocks.en: Tracking meets the 33.3 33.3 ms pose-call contract of Eq. 9 in every real-time desktop and iPhone configuration. Paced on the desktop, CADENCE-RT records a p95 pose time of 32.5 32.5 ms with 3.3 % 3.3\,\% late frames and reaches 33.61 33.61 dB PSNR on Replica-8 (Table 1 , Fig. 5 ). The accuracy-first configuration reaches 38.50 38.50 dB with a larger mapping budget in non-real-time execution (Table S16 ). These configurations provide operating points that balance reconstruction quality and processing time. Fig. 5 a compares their median (open) and worst-scene p95 (filled) timings. On the Apple M5, the default configuration with CPU mapping meets the contract, including with active memory, which adds 0.35 0.35 ms to p95 pose time on average (+WM in Fig. 5 b). With precomputed embeddings, memory inference therefore introduces little tracking overhead. Contract exceedances occur in two Replica sequences under the separate configuration where Metal mapping and depth registration share the GPU. The iPhone 11 Pro Max replays a 15 15 Hz ScanNet++ LiDAR sequence at a p95 pose time of 20.3 20.3 ms without dropping a frame; six short live stereo-depth sessions also meet the contract (Table 4 ). With IMU input and Metal mapping, tracking remains responsive alongside on-device map updates. Table 4 reports pose-time distributions and the fraction of calls above the contract, with device profiles in Table S15 . Across three live two-phone sessions, p95 pose times stay within budget at 10.0 10.0 to 11.3 11.3 ms on the iPhone 15 and 17.0 17.0 to 26.7 26.7 ms on the iPhone 11 Pro Max ( Secs. B.7 and B.5 ). blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented CADENCE, a collaborative Gaussian SLAM system that separates finding correspondences from deciding which aligned evidence may affect another agent’s map.
To this end, it combines sensor-grounded regional ranking, geometric verification, and per-modality confidences.
At the same time, local tracking stays independent of the background collaboration, and the Gaussian map and the verified graph remain the authoritative state.
On unseen houses, the regional memory ranks peer regions with an AUROC of 0.95 0.95 to 0.97 0.97 , and verification keeps false links below 0.5 % 0.5\,\% .
Moreover, confidence-governed sharing allows a peer in a dark scene to contribute its depth while its color is withheld.
The system also runs on commodity hardware.
On iPhones without LiDAR, live two-phone collaboration verifies 535 535 links at a 95th-percentile pose time of 10.0 10.0 to 11.3 11.3 ms.
Taken together, these results suggest that collaborative reconstruction should be evaluated by both the evidence it accepts and the effect of that evidence on the receiving map.

此外,信任管理共享允许在黑暗场景中的对等方贡献其深度,而其颜色则被屏蔽.
该系统还运行于商品硬件上.

总之,这些结果表明,合作重建应当根据其接受的证据和证据对接收地图的影响加以评价。

blocks.en:
All experiments are indoor. Collaboration is evaluated in replay with synthetic barometers (and a synthetic IMU outside ScanNet++) and in live iPhone sessions, where a rigidly joined phone pair replaces ground truth.
Verification may accept geometrically consistent copies of a place unless a physical check separates them, and cue-based confidences miss a peer whose evidence is self-consistent but contradicts the receiver’s map.
Future work will address map-aware confidence estimation and validation on independent multi-phone recordings with real sensors and external ground truth.

blocks.en: A Overview
blocks.zh: 概览

blocks.en:
CADENCE lets several phones, called agents, reconstruct one static indoor scene together while each phone keeps tracking in real time (Fig. 2 ).
Every agent keeps its own world frame and Gaussian map, and only the owning agent modifies its map.
Collaboration therefore decides three things separately: which peer keyframes may show the same place (ranking), whether a proposed match is geometrically correct (verification), and which kinds of peer evidence may change the receiver’s map (permissions).
blocks.zh:
CADENCE让多部电话,称为"特工",在每部电话持续实时跟踪(图2.
每个特工都保留了自己的世界帧和高斯地图,只有拥有的特工才修改了自己的地图.
因此合作分别决定了三件事:哪一个对等键框可以显示同一位置(排名),一个拟议的匹配是否几何正确(验证),以及哪类对等证据可以改变接收者的地图(许可).

blocks.en:
A visual-inertial tracker estimates the pose of every frame from image features, the IMU and, where available, sensor depth.
Its pose call never waits for mapping or collaboration, which run in the background, and is measured against a 33.3 33.3 ms real-time contract.
Keyframes enter bounded queues, and background mapping jobs grow the agent’s Gaussian map within a compute budget.
blocks.zh:
一个可视惯性跟踪器从图像特征,IMU,以及可能时的传感器深度来估计出每个帧的姿势.
它的姿势呼号从不等地图绘制或合作,这种定位或合作在背景中运行,以33.3-33.3毫秒的实时合同来衡量。
Keyframes 输入被绑定的队列, 背景映射任务在计算预算范围内增长代理商的高斯地图 。

blocks.en:
Nine cues describe the image quality, motion, texture, viewpoint, depth and pose reliability of each keyframe and yield four confidences, for pose, geometry, appearance and memory.
The guard turns each confidence into a permission with a threshold, whereas soft weighting scales every update by the smallest confidence.
blocks.zh:
九分点描述每个键框的图像质量、运动、纹理、视角、深度和可靠性,并产生四个置信度,用于姿势、几何、外观和记忆。
后卫将每个信心变成一个有阈值的许可,而以最小的自信对每个更新进行软加权.

blocks.en:
The sensor-grounded world-consistency memory (SG-WCM) summarizes the committed observations of each spatial region from appearance and sensor evidence: region-relative pose, gravity, barometric altitude and observation quality.
It scores how likely a peer keyframe shows each region, and it never changes a map.
blocks.zh:
传感器定位世界一致性记忆(SG-WCM)从外观和传感器证据中总结了每个空间区域的承诺观测:区域相对姿势,重力,气压高度和观测质量.
它得分一个对等键框显示每个区域的可能性,它永远不会改变地图。

blocks.en:
Agents broadcast small announcements for their keyframes.
A receiver ranks candidates by memory score and embedding retrieval (hybrid association), requests one evidence packet, and accepts a relation only if geometric tests on matched features and depth pass, optionally followed by gravity, barometric and consistency checks.
Accepted relations align the peer’s frame in a pose graph, and the permissions then decide how strongly the peer’s pose constraints, geometry, appearance and memory updates enter the receiver.

blocks.en:
This subsection extends Sec. 4.2 and Table 2 .
Table S5 and Fig. S2 add the memory’s evidence one kind at a time (encoding in Eq. 2 and Sec. D.4 ).
In these offline tests, the ground-truth correspondence labels decide which observations are committed to the memory (teacher forcing), so AUROC measures ranking alone, independent of runtime verification.

blocks.en: Part (a) of Table S5 reports the mean and standard deviation over three seeds where available. Each step of the ladder adds one kind of evidence: A0 is raw DINOv3 embedding similarity, A1 the learned visual memory, A2 adds region-relative pose, A3 adds IMU increments (which also changes the tracker poses), A4 adds gravity and altitude, and A5 adds observation quality. The suffix rel expresses gravity and altitude relative to the region’s committed observations and drops the IMU increments; A5rel is the adopted model. WM-test is the world-memory (WM) test split, MP3D k = 0 k{=}0 is first contact pooled over alignment regimes, and Floor is the floor-head AUROC. Bold and underline mark the two best means per column and do not imply statistical significance.
blocks.zh: 表S5(a)部分报告了现有三种种子的平均偏差和标准偏差。 梯子的每一步都增加了一种证据: A0是原始的DINOv3嵌入相似性,A1是已学习到的视觉内存,A2是添加了区域相通的姿势,A3是添加了IMU增量(也改变了跟踪器所构成的增量),A4是增加重力和高度,A5是增加观测质量. 后缀雷尔表示相对于该区域承诺观测的重力和高度,并降低IMU增量;A5雷尔是被采纳的模式. WM-测试是世界-记忆(WM)测试分出,MP3D k = 0 k{=}0是首次接触集合,超越了对齐制度,而地底是地头AUROC. 粗体并下划线标出每栏两种最佳手段,并不意味着统计意义。

blocks.en:
We adopted A5rel based on validation AUROC averaged over domains, not on any single split.
On the memory test split alone, A2 is higher, because inertial increments and quality cues lower that split by 0.003 0.003 and 0.019 0.019 ; the adopted encoding is therefore relative and drops the inertial increments.
Adding inertial evidence (A2 → \to A3) gains + 0.003 +0.003 on Matterport3D, with an interval above zero, and raises floor AUROC, although this step also changes the tracker poses.
Plain similarity stays ahead of A5rel on degraded TUM, and on VAL a descriptor ranks keyframe pairs best; association therefore combines retrieval with the memory (hybrid).
Without an alignment prior (MP3D no-prior stratum), the memory raises AUROC from 0.940 0.940 to 0.953 0.953 , and retrieval handles first contact ( Sec. 3.4 ).
On the low-overlap pairs of the fixed splits, the memory raises AUROC over embedding similarity from 0.926 0.926 to 0.968 0.968 on Matterport3D and from 0.815 0.815 to 0.895 0.895 on 7-Scenes (A0 to A5rel).

在Matterport3D上添加惯性证据(A2 →\去A3)增益+0.003+0.03,间隔高于0,并提升地板AUROC,不过这一步骤也改变了跟踪器所构成的.

The region memory needs 49.5 49.5 KB (full history: 1.1 1.1 MB) and answers in under 0.1 0.1 ms (Table S5 ); the policies answer different labeled queries, so their AUROC values do not rank them.

blocks.en:
This subsection extends Sec. 4.4 with five sharing policies on two Replica VAL scenes (Table S7 , Fig. S3 ): own is the receiver’s PSNR change against Solo on views outside the peer’s window, and peer is the change against Merge in the region that only the peer observed.
Rows are grouped by the guard’s own-view loss, bold and underline mark the two best values among the own and among the peer columns, and the figure uses one diverging scale (red loss, blue gain).
Photometric degradations begin after a clean overlap, whereas IMU corruption and sent-pose noise last the whole window.
A healthy peer adds 6.42 6.42 dB in the peer region at a cost of 0.62 0.62 dB own-view PSNR (office0: + 10.32 +10.32 and − 1.51 -1.51 dB; office1: + 2.53 +2.53 and + 0.27 +0.27 dB).

各行按警卫自身视差进行分组,用粗体和下划线标出本行和同级列中的两个最佳值,数字使用一个相差的尺度(红色损失,蓝色增益).

blocks.en:
The two policies differ in two ways, which these complete-system comparisons do not separate: soft weighting scales every permitted update by the smallest of the four confidences of each raw frame report, whereas the guard thresholds each modality and caps each report by a running summary of the peer.
Table S8 shows the three conditions that separate them (PSNR in dB, depth error in cm, own-view depth over all own views, Cov. = coverage change).
Under low light, both keep the peer’s depth, but the guard’s threshold blocks the color that soft weighting admits at a small weight.
Figure S4 follows the office0 low-light run, whose delivered peer frames stay dark for the first 800 frames. Its middle panels give the frame PSNR, its change against Solo and the luma error (white none, dark red at least 60 60 gray levels); its right panels plot the own-view PSNR change against Solo and the peer-region depth error and coverage against no sharing.
On the DEV scenes room0 and office3, with the peer at 10 % 10\,\% illumination, the guard changes own views by − 0.32 -0.32 dB and keeps + 6.58 +6.58 dB of peer-region gain over no sharing (ungated: − 0.74 -0.74 and − 5.02 -5.02 dB); at 50 % 50\,\% illumination, the peer-region gains are + 6.74 +6.74 and + 1.58 +1.58 dB.
Under bad view angle and noisy sent poses, the guard admits geometry that clears θ g \theta_{g} but disagrees with the receiver’s map, which no cue measures, so the receiver’s own depth error rises; soft weighting ties this geometry to the weakest cue.

blocks.en:
This subsection extends Sec. 4.6 .
Table S16 and Fig. 5 separate desktop checks of the real-time contract (pose-call p95 at most 33.3 33.3 ms, Eq. 9 ) from Apple device measurements.
The real-time desktop configuration and the default M5 configuration (CPU mapping, no depth registration) meet the contract in every variant; the accuracy-first configuration does not.
Over 1660 deterministic ScanNet++ frames, M5 and desktop give identical tracked-frame, keyframe and job counts, and a tracking-only M5 run reproduces the M5 trajectory.
The 0.17 0.17 cm difference between the two devices therefore does not come from Gaussian optimization.
With matched schedules, the devices differ by 0.12 0.12 dB, and every tested Metal kernel meets its bound (Table S19 ) on M5 and iPhone.
Per 66.7 66.7 s sequence, evaluation included, the paced real-time run takes 4.3 4.3 min and the accuracy-first online run 213.5 213.5 min (Table S16 c).
Real-time pacing of one VAL phone replay keeps tracking on time and trades map PSNR for it ( 21.09 21.09 to 17.14 17.14 dB), because mapping then gets less time per frame.

Only the Replica tracker registers depth on the GPU; the phone engine does not.
When Metal mapping shares the M5 GPU with this registration, it exceeds the contract on two Replica sequences (Table S16 b).
On the A13 iPhone (Tables 4 and S15 a), the on-device benchmark ( Sec. D.9 ) selects Metal mapping, which runs each job 1.76 × 1.76\times faster than the CPU optimizer in the 4 GB profile, and the real-time replay ( 661 661 mapping jobs) stays under the tier’s 150 150 k Gaussian cap.
In live stereo-depth sessions, the thermal governor lowers the input rate at the serious thermal state, and tracking continues.
The DINOv3-S/16 keyframe encoder (run offline in the evaluations) runs on the M5 Neural Engine, which tracking and mapping do not use, and occupies under 5 5 % of it at the 5.7 5.7 keyframes/s of the phone replay.

C Evaluation Protocol

blocks.en:
Replica-8 [ 23 , 26 ] evaluates single-agent reconstruction. MA-Replica [ 11 ] and three-agent Matterport3D walks [ 3 ] evaluate collaboration, replaying all agents in one process, interleaved in time.
ScanNet++ iPhone sequences [ 31 ] provide LiDAR depth, real IMU data, recorded ARKit poses and laser-registered ground truth over the first 2000 frames. All barometers, and all inertial streams outside ScanNet++, are synthetic, so the studies that use them test mechanisms rather than real multi-phone sensing.
Synthetic IMU samples ( 200 200 Hz) follow an error model calibrated on 15 15 real iPhone sequences of the ADVIO dataset [ 6 ] , with white noise of 6.7 × 10 − 4 6.7\times 10^{-4} rad s − 1 / Hz {}^{-1}/\sqrt{\text{Hz}} for the gyroscope and 3.5 × 10 − 3 3.5\times 10^{-3} m s − 2 / Hz {}^{-2}/\sqrt{\text{Hz}} for the accelerometer, bias random walks of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} and 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} in the same units per second, turn-on biases of σ = 0.005 \sigma=0.005 rad/s and 0.05 0.05 m/s 2 , and a 0.5 % 0.5\,\% scale error per axis.
Synthetic barometers ( 0.9 0.9 Hz) add 0.013 0.013 m white noise. Under a shared altitude reference, each agent’s pressure follows its height in one building frame plus a per-device drift ( 0.01 0.01 m/ s \sqrt{\text{s}} ), because phones in the same building share the same weather. Under per-walk zeros, each agent’s altitude instead starts at zero.
Each dataset serves non-commercial research under its own terms: the Replica Research License, the Matterport3D data-use agreement, the Microsoft Research license for 7-Scenes, CC BY 4.0 for TUM RGB-D [ 24 ] and the non-redistributable ScanNet++ terms. We redistribute no raw ScanNet++ or Matterport3D data.
We tune on the DEV split (three scenes) and make design decisions on the VAL split (six scenes). Three held-out phone splits (TEST, TEST2, TEST3; 11 11 , 12 12 and 12 12 reported scenes) contain disjoint scenes from the official validation partition. Each split was evaluated once, with the configuration frozen at that time; only TEST3 tests the final configuration.
The collaboration studies use Replica room0/office3 (DEV), office0/office1 and four Matterport3D houses (VAL), and eight Matterport3D houses unseen in memory training. The unseen houses were evaluated with the first frozen configuration; an earlier version of the system had run once on them.
The memory trains on 29 29 other Matterport3D houses, Replica room0, room1, office0, office1 and office2, five 7-Scenes scenes (chess, fire, office, pumpkin, redkitchen) and 29 29 ScanNet++ scenes. It selects its epoch on the four VAL houses, Replica office3, 7-Scenes stairs and the six VAL phone scenes.
The eight unseen houses and all TEST, TEST2 and TEST3 phone scenes are disjoint from both sets. The Replica and 7-Scenes collaboration scenes, however, are training scenes, so those studies test verification and gating, not the generalization of the memory.

Online is causal reconstruction without refinement. Deterministic runs complete all earned mapping work between frames, so an Online result alone is not a real-time claim. Refined adds 30 000 iterations (Replica) or 1000 mapping jobs (phones) that also optimize poses, degree-2 spherical harmonics (SH) and an affine exposure model. Paced feeds frames in real time at 30 30 Hz, and CADENCE-RT is the configuration with a smaller map budget and RGB color. Merge integrates verified relations and peer points; Share also uses aligned peer keyframes.
ATE is the position RMSE (cm) after rigid alignment, over tracked frames, and † marks coverage below 95 95 %. The keyframe ATE (ATE-KF) uses every fifth frame per agent. Every method renders every tenth evaluation frame at its own estimated pose, mapping keyframes included, so the image metrics score training views. In Refined, the exposure affine of a frame is interpolated in time from the affines fitted at its neighboring keyframes, not fitted to the frame itself. Photo-SLAM saves its map with its final trajectory, and we report its scores on its own sparse keyframes as separate entries.

blocks.en:
World-memory ablations use three seeds and paired cluster-bootstrap intervals. Phone comparisons use paired scene-bootstrap 95 95 % intervals and treat differences below 0.05 0.05 dB or 0.05 0.05 cm as ties. Every SLAM result is a single deterministic run, and false-link bounds are exact Clopper-Pearson intervals.
The criterion fixed before the TEST3 evaluation requires at least ten paired wins out of twelve scenes (one-sided sign test, p = 0.019 p=0.019 ), an interval excluding zero, and a mean effect of at least 1 1 dB PSNR, 0.02 0.02 SSIM, 0.03 0.03 LPIPS or 30 30 % ATE reduction with a lower median.
Phone baselines run the official ORB-SLAM3 [ 2 ] , GS-ICP SLAM [ 10 ] and Photo-SLAM [ 13 ] code on the same replays, together with the recorded ARKit trajectory. Association controls use descriptor retrieval or raw DINOv3 similarity [ 22 ] , followed by the CADENCE verifier.
Inertial ORB-SLAM3 completed 1 1 of 6 6 VAL scenes, and 4 4 of 11 11 , 3 3 of 12 12 and 11 11 of 12 12 scenes on TEST, TEST2 and TEST3. Only TEST3 used a patched adapter, which interpolates the 60 60 Hz IMU to 240 240 Hz and adds numerical guards, so the completion rates mix scene and adapter effects.
Accuracy and cost measurements run on a desktop RTX 5070 and a Linux RTX PRO 4000, and device latency measurements run on an Apple M5 and an iPhone 11 Pro Max. Published rows keep their own protocols and serve as context rather than as a ranking.

The world frame aligns with the gravity direction averaged over the first 20 accelerometer samples (static start). Without an IMU, the world frame is the first body frame and the tracker drops the rotation prior.

blocks.en:
The 95-d query of Sec. 3.3 holds the region token (32) and a presence flag (1), region-relative position (3), orientation (6), quality cues (9), confidences (4), inertial increments with uncertainties (11), altitude and gravity evidence (5, Eq. 2 ), a floor hypothesis (2), evidence masks (6) and 16 similarity statistics against the committed embeddings. These statistics provide a bounded summary of the region history in place of raw embeddings, and the adopted model zeroes the inertial block.
The perceptron has 33,702 33{,}702 parameters and outputs six logits and the 32-d increment. Its static/dynamic head is reserved for dynamic scenes; it is untrained and inactive here, because all evaluated scenes are static.
The embeddings are DINOv3 Vision Transformer (ViT-S/16) [ 22 ] class-token (CLS) and generalized-mean (GeM) pooled features of the gray image at a 448 px long side (768 values, float16), computed offline.

Training uses 2 2 m regions from Matterport3D [ 3 ] , Replica [ 23 ] , 7-Scenes [ 21 ] and ScanNet++ [ 31 ] , and each pseudo-agent is a separate tracker run in its own world frame.
The pipeline synthesizes inertial and barometric streams from ground truth except on ScanNet++ (real IMU, no barometer), with a per-sequence peer barometer offset ( σ = 0.3 \sigma=0.3 m).
To cover every alignment state, a peer pose arrives unaligned and masked (40 %), coarsely aligned (40 %, 20 ∘ 20^{\circ} /1 m) or finely aligned (20 %, 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} /0.25 m).
The memory visit spans four keyframes, and visibility is the co-visible depth share. Floor compatibility is same-level identity on Matterport3D, and an observation counts as reliable if its tracked motion over 0.5 s lies within 2 cm and 1 ∘ 1^{\circ} of ground truth.
AdamW (learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , one-cycle schedule, batch 64, weight decay 0.05) trains the network with hidden dropout 0.2, weight averaging (0.999), input noise (0.1), evidence-group dropout (0.3) and log-variances clamped to [ − 3 , 3 ] [-3,3] . Training keeps the averaged weights with the best domain-averaged validation correspondence AUROC, here epoch 16 of the adopted run (seed 0). This run stopped after epoch 26 of at most 40 with a patience of 10 epochs.

An evidence packet holds a gray thumbnail, depth points and FAST features with steered Binary Robust Independent Elementary Features (BRIEF) descriptors [ 1 ] (contents and sizes in Table S11 a). The codec computes these descriptors in integer arithmetic, so every platform obtains identical bits.
For each peer, the system estimates only a clock offset from the request-response timestamps of its messages.

blocks.en: D.7 Backend Parity, Arithmetic and Refusals

blocks.en:
Accelerated work passes through two interfaces, each with a CPU reference: the optimizer (forward pass, fused loss and backward pass with SSIM, sparse Adam) and registration (linearizing Eq. S3 ).
The test suite also checks the references themselves: the tiled CPU rasterizer matches a per-pixel renderer (image error below 2 ⋅ 10 − 5 2\cdot 10^{-5} , depth below 10 − 4 10^{-4} , gradient relative L 2 L_{2} below 10 − 4 10^{-4} , maximum relative gradient error below 10 − 3 10^{-3} ), and the reference backend is bit-identical to the CPU optimizer.
Every build tests each CUDA and Metal kernel against the bounds of Tab. S19 (Metal also on the phone). To confirm that the test can fail, a deliberately perturbed Adam step must exceed the Metal bound by more than 100 × 100\times .

blocks.en:
Both backends keep results independent of thread scheduling.
On CUDA, the optimizer kernels compile without fused multiply-add, Adam runs in double precision, and the backward pass reduces in fixed-order trees without atomics, with losses and per-splat sums in double precision.
Apple GPUs lack 64-bit floats, so Metal runs in single precision with fixed-order reductions and safe math (no reassociation), while the host adds the partial sums in double precision.
Registration resolves surfel association by atomic minima over packed depth-index keys and remains run-to-run deterministic on both backends.
Without compensated summation, the backends agree within the bounds rather than exactly.

两个后端都保持结果独立于线程调度.
在CUDA上,最优化的内核编译而无引信相乘-add,亚当运行的精度为双倍,而后传的精度则会减少在无相通的固定顺序树上,损失和每平分的精度为双倍.
Apple GPU缺乏64位浮点数,因此Metal在单精度下运行,并有固定的顺序减速和安全的数学(没有再结合),而主机则以双精度加分.
登记解决了由原子微米在已包装的深度指数键上相接而成的冲浪问题,并在两个后端保持运行中的确定性。
没有补偿的汇总,后端在界限内而不是准确商定.

Only registration falls back (CUDA, then Metal, then the CPU reference), because all three backends meet the same bounds.

blocks.en: D.8 Deterministic and Paced Modes
blocks.zh: D.8 决定因素和平静模式

blocks.en:
A run ( T 1 : N , 𝒢 ) = Φ ( x 1 : N ; θ , σ , b ) (T_{1:N},\mathcal{G})=\Phi(x_{1:N};\theta,\sigma,b) depends on sensor input x x , configuration θ \theta , schedule σ \sigma (which background job runs after which packet) and backend b b ; the tracker does not access the Gaussian map.
Deterministic mode makes the schedule a function of input and configuration, σ = σ ⁡ ( x , θ ) \sigma=\sigma(x,\theta) : without a background thread or pacing, one tick of four mapping jobs follows each packet, the pose graph runs eight iterations without a time limit, the controller stays at level 0, and the run ends after three idle ticks (at most 10 5 10^{5} ).
As a result, poses and maps are bit-identical on one binary, and a test checks this property over 160 frames under simulated critical pressure. Across machines, we compare results empirically and use tracking-only runs to exclude Gaussian optimization.
Paced mode releases frame t t at the wall time of the first frame plus its timestamp offset and ticks the background thread every 10 ms. The benchmark counts frames that arrive more than 10 ms late, and a run lagging more than 200 ms is invalid.
For example, with 25 ms jobs, a 20 ms live budget completes one job per tick, whereas deterministic mode completes four.
Reported p95 values cover all frames of a run, and controller-level shares are per-frame histograms.

blocks.en: D.9 Apple Deployment
blocks.zh: D.9 苹果部署

blocks.en:
The portable C++20 core has no platform headers; CUDA and Metal form backend layers, and a C interface serves live and replay sessions to the iOS app.
The Metal optimizer projects, sorts and bins Gaussians on the CPU and runs compositing, SSIM, the backward pass and Adam on the GPU, encoding each pass into one command buffer with a single wait.
The app caches compiled pipelines on disk and rebuilds them when they are stale or corrupt, and a test checks that every cache state yields the same result. At launch, the app runs a GPU self-test that also warms the cache.
blocks.zh:
便携式C++20核心没有平台头; CUDA和Metal组成后端层,一个C接口为iOS应用提供活出和回放会话服务.
Metal优化器项目,类型和在CPU上并运行composition,SSIM,后传和GPU上的Adam,将每个通过编码成一个指令缓冲器,一个等待.
应用缓存在磁盘上编译了管线,并在被扭曲或腐败时重建管线,并进行测试检查,每个缓存状态得出同样的结果. 在发布时,该应用程序运行一个GPU自试,同样能为缓存取暖.

blocks.en:
The app probes capabilities rather than the model name and picks the first available depth source in the order of Tab. S20 b. The Metal optimizer requires Apple GPU family 6 (A13) or newer.
Memory tiers ( Tab. S20 a) change budgets only and leave resolution, objective and thresholds unchanged, although eviction under a cap changes which Gaussians exist.
The CPU optimizer uses max ⁡ ( 2 , cores − 2 ) \max(2,\text{cores}-2) threads.
In automatic mode, an on-device benchmark of under 10 s times short CPU and Metal calls on a seeded job, predicts a full job on each backend and picks the faster one. The app does not run this benchmark mid-session, when hot or in Low Power Mode. Without a benchmark record, GPU family 6 or newer selects Metal, and a forced setting overrides both rules.
For refused jobs, the app also keeps a retry profile without SSIM and with RGB color; because it changes the objective, it provides no evidence of backend parity.

内存分级(Tab.S20a)只改变预算,使解析度、目标和阈值保持不变,尽管在高斯人存在的上限下驱逐的变化。

Stereo depth provides relative accuracy only ( Tab. S20 b), so live stereo sessions serve as feasibility checks; quantitative phone results come from recorded LiDAR sequences [ 31 ] .
Core Motion provides the IMU (100 Hz) and barometer on the host clock.
A watchdog reports memory use to the controller every second and, at 0.90 of the limit, ends the session with results saved.
Input decimation by the thermal governor ( Tab. S20 c) is the only adaptation that changes the tracker input, and this decimation is inactive in every evaluated replay.
The viewer draws Gaussians as instanced GPU quads at 30 fps (60 during gestures, lower under load or heat as in Tab. S20 c) and scales resolution to about 10 ms of GPU time per frame.

blocks.en: D.11 Configurations
blocks.zh: D.11 配置

blocks.en:
All configurations share the tracker of Sec. 3.2 , plus profile-specific additions, and run at most ten iterations per mapping job. Scheduled profiles use the credits of Sec. D.3 , whereas the default “CPU mapping” configuration has neither credits nor depth registration.
Collaboration runs (Solo, Merge or Share; Sec. C ) replay all agents in one process over a loopback transport. Learned ranking is active whenever a model is loaded, and each experiment sets the physical checks, the floor estimator with shared altitude and the blur handling.
The device measurements use the configurations of Table S15 c on an Apple M5 MacBook Air (passively cooled, 8-core GPU, 16 GB), an iPhone 11 Pro Max (A13, 4 GB, no LiDAR) and a desktop RTX 5070 as CUDA reference.
Each run stores its configuration, power source and thermal state at start and end, so that it can be repeated.

blocks.en: E Scope and Protocol Qualifications
blocks.zh: E 范围和议定书资格

blocks.en:
Published numbers serve only as context, because each was obtained under that system’s own protocol.
On Replica-8, the eleven published RGB-D systems report a PSNR of 34.11 34.11 to 44.87 44.87 dB, against our 38.50 38.50 dB. On MA-Replica, published collaborative Gaussian systems report a merged ATE-KF of 0.14 0.14 to 0.25 0.25 cm and a PSNR of 34.26 34.26 to 41.35 41.35 dB, against our 0.35 0.35 cm and 37.26 37.26 dB (Table S12 ).
The map-level depth check is not part of the default system; its improvement under noisy sent poses is concentrated in office0, and it misses IMU-corrupted peer poses ( Sec. B.1 ).
The memory is trained on 2 2 m regions but runs on 5 5 m regions at test time (sensitivity study in Sec. B.2 ).
Four of the eight unseen houses remain unlinked under every policy, the MA-Replica map caps were chosen on the same scenes on which they are evaluated, and every SLAM result comes from a single deterministic run.
Finally, some Replica and 7-Scenes collaboration scenes are part of the memory training data, whereas the unseen Matterport3D houses and the held-out phone scenes are excluded from it ( Sec. C ).

地图层深度检查不是默认系统的一部分;在响亮的发送外观下其改进集中在Office0,它错过了IMU-corrupted palers (Sec. B.1.).
记忆在2个2米区域进行训练,但在试验时运行在5个5米区域(敏感度研究在Sec.B.2.)。
